subject: [PATCH v4 1/7] mm: support promotion-only NUMA hinting scans

2026-09-30.patch_summary: This patch introduces a new mode for NUMA hinting scans that only promotes pages to higher tiers without scanning the entire VMA. The global balancing mode is used to determine the intent of an individual protection walk, and the patch adds a new flag MM_CP_PROT_NUMA_PROMO_ONLY to select this promotion-only mode. The change-protection flags are built in task_numa_work() based on the balancing mode, and folio_can_map_prot_numa() derives the single-threaded private state at the point of use instead of adding another precomputed boolean to the protection-walk interface. This patch is required for memory-tiering fixes and must be accompanied by them when backported.
